newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KNP BT declines comment on Leykam bid.
newsitem.headline: KNP BT declines comment on Leykam bid.

text.p: Dutch paper, packaging and office equipment group NV Koninklijke KNP BT on Wednesday declined to comment on possible candidates to buy its 70-percent owned paper division KNP Leykam.
"We do not give information about any contacts we have with possible partners," KNP BT spokesman Patrick van Leeuwen said.

Earlier, Dutch newspaper De Telegraaf said Swedish paper maker Stora would make a bid for KNP Leykam. But in Sweden a Stora spokesman said his company had not showed any particular interest in the unit.
Van Leeuwen stressed that KNP was not looking for possible buyers of Leykam but was eyeing partners for the subsidiary.
In September KNP BT said it would probably abandon large investment plans for KNP Leykam and would seek a partner for the loss-making paper producer.

If KNP Leykam could be merged with a partner this would be considered given the ongoing concentration process in the paper-making industry, even if it would mean a dilution of KNP BT's stake, KNP said last month.
It said it expected the profitability of the paper industry to remain weak in the next two to three years.
